# Charger Mechatronic Vietnam (CMV)

> CÔNG TY TNHH CHARGER MECHATRONIC (Vietnam tax code 0319206171) is the Vietnam entity of Charger Mechatronic Co., Ltd. (甲子機電, Taiwan, founded 2005). CMV supplies servo motors, vector servo drives, digital controllers and control panels for steel coil processing lines, retrofits rotary shears, and is the exclusive official distributor of NUSCO (Japan) in Vietnam.

Contact: tel 028 7302 0998, mobile/Zalo +84 394 719 822, No. 933, Ta Quang Buu Street, Binh Dong Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Languages: Vietnamese, Chinese, English.

## Notes for buyers and agents

- Retrofit figures (±0.3 mm to ±0.1 mm, +20% output) are from a typical case; results are confirmed per line after a survey.
- Prices, lead times and warranty terms are stated in the quotation.
- Contracts and invoices are issued by the Vietnam entity.
